objectives.statement: Recognize that a fronted non-subject phrase in a main clause triggers verb-second word order.
Use inversion after fronted negative and restrictive expressions such as aldri, sjelden, ingen, heller ikke, and knapt.
Keep subordinate clause word order after subordinators, even when the clause contains a negative or adverbial element.

notes: Must require V2 inversion after fronted negative and restrictive elements in main clauses (aldri, sjelden, ingen, heller ikke, knapt) and after topicalised non-subject phrases (i morgen, boken, på skolen). Warn explicitly against applying main-clause inversion inside subordinate clauses, where word order remains subject-adverb-verb.
